title: OFIS Efficiency
subtitle: Work Smarter, Ditch The Hustle
description: Save money and time by managing your resources more efficiently with OFIS’s Efficiency Package. This package will help you optimize your office operations with:

features.title: Smart HVAC and Lighting Management System
features.description:
Deploy a Smart HVAC and Lighting Management System to automate HVAC and lighting functions according to office operations and schedules.
Enable adjustments based on environmental conditions to optimize energy efficiency.
Provide a single dashboard for monitoring energy consumption and allow users to override operations via application, switches, or voice commands. Additionally, generate electricity usage reports and offer integration with existing Building Automation Systems for seamless functionality.

features.title: Smart Energy Optimization
features.description:
Implement energy usage analytics to monitor and analyze energy consumption patterns.
Utilize anomaly detection to identify irregularities in energy usage for proactive maintenance.
Offer a single dashboard with automation features and an alert system for efficient management and timely response to energy-related issues.

features.title: Building Automation System
features.description:
Establish connectivity with HVAC, lighting, security, and building protection systems to centralize control and management.
Provide a single dashboard for monitoring and controlling all building electronics, ensuring ease of operation and oversight.
Offer open integration capabilities with other systems to enhance interoperability and functionality.

title: OFIS Safety and Security
subtitle: Taking Safety and Security to The Next Level
description: Transform your smart office solution with a comprehensive, end-to-end OFIS solution to safeguard your employees and all workplaces. This package includes a Surveillance and Tracking System, Time and Attendance System, and Access Control System.

features.title: Surveillance and Tracking System
features.description:
Integrates a Video Analytic System with surveillance infrastructure for real-time anomaly detection.
Utilizes active/passive RFID, face recognition, and access control to track employees and visitors seamlessly.
Implements advanced asset tracking and integrates a 3D realistic dashboard with an Alert System and Incident SOP for enhanced operational efficiency and incident management.

features.title: Attendance System
features.description:
Supports various on-site attendance methods like smart card, biometric, or face recognition.
Facilitates remote work with online attendance via GPS and map integration for WFH and mobile offices.
Seamlessly integrates with ERP systems for comprehensive attendance management.

features.title: Access Control System
features.description:
Ensure office security by preventing unauthorized access to restricted areas.
Provide diverse access methods such as smart cards, biometrics, or face recognition for entry.
Integrate seamlessly with front desk, smart meeting rooms, and other OFIS packages, and also allow
integration with Building Automation, Fire, and PAVA Systems within the building.

title: OFIS Seat Management System
subtitle: Boost Productivity, Spark Collaboration
description: Transform your workplace environment with the OFIS Seat Management System package, a smart solution that helps you manage your employees’ seating arrangements for optimal productivity and convenience. With this package, you can enjoy:

features.title: Desk Booking System
features.description:
Support a mobile office setup where employees do not have assigned seats within the office premises.
Enable a seat booking system to facilitate workspace reservation.
Provide office amenities such as seats, phones, and other facilities to employees upon their arrival at the office.

features.title: Desk Facility Automation System
features.description:
Enable desk automation for electricity management.
Control desk functions via an application or display interface.
Utilize QR code technology to activate desk facilities, and integrate seamlessly with pantry, cleaning services, and front desk operations.

features.title: Office Automation Application
features.description:
Enhance efficiency in office operations through an application designed to assist with a range of tasks.
Manage vacation requests, leave approvals, and overtime submissions seamlessly.
Facilitate borrowing and returning of items or vehicles, along with interdepartmental communication, and additional functionalities.

title: OFIS Service and Facility
subtitle: Comprehensive Services for Worry-Free Operations
description: Create a highly convenient, customizable, secure, and modern smart office with the OFIS Service and Facility Package. This package will help you manage additional facilities to enhance employee productivity and save more costs. With this package, you can enjoy:

features.title: Parking System
features.description:
Efficiently oversee parking spaces utilizing occupancy sensors for monitoring.
Enable membership access, offering options for card membership or License Plate Recognition.
Utilize a mobile application to identify available parking spaces and seamlessly integrate with the payment system.

features.title: Smart Locker System
features.description:
Implement a system-managed locker system tailored for employees’ convenience.
Offer access options via card, face recognition, or application for locker opening.
Seamlessly integrate with all OFIS Systems, including access control and attendance tracking, for comprehensive management.

features.title: Cleaning Service and Pantry
features.description:
Facilitate job orders for cleaning services through the system.
Offer the capability to arrange meals for meetings or employees as needed.
Automatically notify and track orders sent directly to the designated person in charge (PIC), with reporting and dashboard functionalities available for monitoring and analysis.

title: OFIS Smart Front Desk
subtitle: Manage Visitors Access More Effectively
description: Boost your office productivity and efficiency with OFIS’ Smart Front Desk package, a comprehensive solution for managing visitor access to your office. This package includes:

features.title: Visitor Management System
features.description:
Implement a comprehensive visitor management system to register, grant access, and monitor visitors throughout their visit duration.
Enable temporary access using card or face recognition systems for streamlined visitor entry.
Automatically notify employees upon visitor arrival and integrate with Smart Meeting Rooms for meeting attendance and information dissemination. Additionally, integrate with digitalization for a wayfinding system.
Offer a visitor tracking dashboard displaying real-time daily traffic for enhanced monitoring and analysis.

features.title: Self-Registration Kiosk
features.description:
Enable visitor self-registration and data acquisition through e-KTP and invitation QR codes, providing a convenient and efficient process.
Offer customizable design options to tailor the system according to specific needs and branding preferences.
Grant temporary access to visitors via card or face recognition methods, ensuring seamless entry and security management.

features.title: Wayfinding System
features.description:
Implement a wayfinding system designed to guide individuals through unfamiliar environments, ensuring clarity and ease of navigation.
Provide intuitive maps and routes displayed on screens or accessible via apps, eliminating the need for users to guess their location or destination.
Seamlessly integrate the wayfinding system with the OFIS Package to enhance overall office functionality and user experience.

title: OFIS Smart Meeting Room
subtitle: Work Smarter with Smart Meeting for Every Need and Budget
description:
In the era of hybrid work, virtual meetings require innovative tools and resources. The OFIS Smart Meeting Room is a comprehensive solution that includes both the booking and all the supporting facilities for conducting effective meetings. With this package, you can enjoy:  
Booking System Software: Manage your meeting room reservations with ease and convenience. You can:
  * Book, cancel, or extend your meeting room anytime, anywhere.
  * Automatically integrate your booking with Outlook and Google Calendars for reminders.
  * Order food and beverage from the receptionist or hospitality department before or during the meeting.
  * Invite internal and external attendees via email and send them QR codes to access the meeting room.
  * Edit the meeting room name and invitation template to suit your preferences.
  * Approve or reject the meeting room requests from other users.


This module divided by two, for users and admins. Users as an application user can book and cancel from anywhere in the system at any time. Meanwhile, Admin as administrator operator who has the right to enter data that appears on user display, such as meeting room name, meeting room capacity, invitation template, and others.

features.title: Booking System
features.description:
Implement a QR Code-based Meeting Room Booking System, allowing convenient booking, cancellation, and extension of meetings through approval processes.
Integrate seamlessly with pantry and cleaning services, front desk, security systems, and wayfinding systems to streamline operations and enhance visitor experience.
Enable integration with Google and Outlook calendar systems for efficient scheduling and coordination, and utilize digital signage for both information dissemination and access control purposes.

features.title: Room Facility Automation System
features.description:
Provide automation for air conditioning, lighting, and door lock security systems to enhance comfort and security.
Enable control over teleconference systems, interactive displays, projectors, smart glass, and other meeting room electronics through various means such as applications, tablets within the meeting room, voice commands, or augmented reality.
Offer integration with teleconference systems and room audio-visual devices for seamless operation and enhanced meeting experiences.
